params.prompt: Original 16-bit pixel-art background for a side-view 2D fighting game, 16:9 panoramic composition. Crisp square pixel clusters, restrained 32-color arcade palette, clean stepped outlines, rich but readable atmosphere. Cobalt blue, scarlet red and golden yellow accents. NO characters, people, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, HUD or borders. Camera level and fixed, not isometric. All objects are scenery behind the fighting line. The bottom 30 percent is a continuous EMPTY horizontal walkable foreground spanning the full width, with no props or obstacles in front of the fighters. Strong layers: distant sky/interior, midground landmark, calm foreground. Highest contrast near scenery edges, a clear quiet middle for large fighters. Do not paint a floor grid over the characters' space. This is a stage landscape, not a sprite sheet. Golden-hour yacht marina and beach. A sleek white luxury yacht moored across the middle distance, turquoise and cobalt water, red nautical flags, distant coastline, palms at the extreme sides. Golden sky reflected in water. Warm golden sand and a wide weathered wooden promenade make the empty lower fighting lane. Welcoming vivid summer atmosphere.
